request.question: Adopt overlay:high-criticality-review in this project? a scope touching a critical component carries the stricter review its criticality asks for.
request.context:
capability:overlay:high-criticality-review
Introduced in POSE 6.0.0. Applied with `pose adopt --request <this id> --apply` or by `pose setup` once answered.

options.consequence: turned on, dated the day it is applied; earlier work is not re-judged
stays off; the reason is recorded so it is not asked again
stays off; asked again under a newer POSE
